henri: quick flag on Console > Pipelines (compact rows)  the right-side action icons overlap the row click area when you try to tap fast. I hit the row instead of the menu twice. :grimacing:
maya: ugh, can repro on mac/chrome. looks like compact spacing tokens brought the action-strip over the row hit area.
kevin: i'd avoid changing global spacing tokens. options: expand the button's hit area with a ::before/::after pseudo element (pointer-events: none), or increase internal padding and visually crop with negative margin so visuals stay compact. Also ensure keyboard focus isn't affected.
henri: good call. mobile/touch fallback should guarantee a 44px min tap target. also a copy/accessibility nit: toasts saying just "Saved" are ambiguous when multiple saves queue. screen reader users can't tell which resource saved.
ui-bot: recs: 1) implement local hit-area expansion (pseudo element or internal padding) and keep pointer-events none on the pseudo to preserve focus outline; 2) use :focus-within to enable pointer-events on action-strip if applying pointer-events toggles; 3) enforce 44px min tap target on touch media; 4) make toasts contextual ("Pipeline saved", "Run queued") and use aria-live="polite" for successes, assertive for errors.
maya: i'll whip up a quick prototype and screenshots by Fri, including iPhone simulator checks. kevin: i'll add a Cypress e2e asserting clicking an action doesn't trigger row navigation.
henri: tagging @frontend for visibility. action items: prototype + mobile check (maya), cypress test (kevin), toast copy variants (maya/henri). ui-bot: summary noted. :white_check_mark:
